gap_candidates.description: Define the canonical `object_kind` enum in `Contracts_V0.md`. | The canonical minimum field set is: `target_kind`; `project_id`; one canonical target selector (`subject_id` OR `object_kind` + `object_id`) | Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
exact_missing_items: The canonical `object_kind` set: conversational/upstream: `thread`, `message`, `wizard`, `usage_event`; runtime/execution: `run`, `node`, `attempt`, `scheduler_pass`, `blocked_episode`, `safe_point`, `remediation`; orchestration rewrite: `feature_seam`, `work_package`, `lane`, `worktree`, `concern`, `promotion`, `graph_patch`, `graph_generation`

`object_id` must use existing canonical ids: `thread_id`, `message_id`, `wizard_id`, `run_id`, `attempt_id`, `scheduler_pass_id`, `blocked_sequence` in `{ run_id, node_id }` scope, `safe_point_id`, `remediation_root_id`, `lane_id`, `worktree_id`, concern/promotion/graph-patch/graph-generation ids when defined
`tier`, `tier_id`, raw widget ids, panel ids, and serialization tokens do not belong in `object_kind`.
If new object families appear, they must be added deliberately, not ad hoc in surface docs.
The canonical minimum field set is: `target_kind`; `project_id`; one canonical target selector (`subject_id` OR `object_kind` + `object_id`)
`project_id` is required. Exactly one canonical target selector is required.

What is NOT a base `route_target` field: `usage_event_ref`, `wizard_id`, `wizard_step`, `message_id`, `artifact_id`, `document_id`, `workflow_run_id`, `scheduler_pass_id`, `safe_point_id`, `remediation_root_id`, `line`, `range`, per-surface state (`active_subview`, compare target, panel layout, browser tab state, widget layout)
Use `subject_id` only when the target is canonical renderable/openable content.
Use `object_kind` + `object_id` for all runtime, governance, conversational, and workflow objects.
Put the classification rule directly in `Contracts_V0.md`.
Keep `subject_id` frozen to the two canonical families until a new cross-surface content identity proves necessary.
`subject_id` is not a second generic object taxonomy. If `subject_id` expands carelessly, the whole routing model becomes muddy again.
stale_tokens: raw widget ids as object_kind values
canonical_replacement_hints: object_kind = node | attempt | scheduler_pass | blocked_episode for tier-era pivots
object_kind + object_id for wizard_id, message_id, usage_event, scheduler_pass_id, safe_point_id, remediation_root_id
